routes.name: Norse crossing, western Norway to Iceland
citations: Landnámabók and Íslendingabók (12th-13th c.), see The Book of Settlements, trans. H. Pálsson and P. Edwards (Winnipeg, 1972)

routes.notes: The sailing directions in Landnámabók run from Norway past Shetland and the Faroes to Iceland. Line is our sketch.

citations: Constantine VII Porphyrogenitus, De Administrando Imperio, ch. 9 (10th c.)

routes.notes: Constantine VII describes the Rus' boats coming down the Dnieper past the rapids to the Black Sea. River and portage line sketched by us.
